source: Written from this folder's facts.json on 2026-09-18, before any holdout trial. Sealed with the state: not used until a candidate has passed on the primary state.

questions.question: What does the project's public repository hold?
questions.correct: The code, the experiments, the raw outputs and the decisions

questions.question: Under which contract are experiments adjudicated?
questions.correct: The V4 evidence contract

questions.question: What were the verdicts of the first two memory experiments?
questions.correct: Both were REJECT

questions.question: Why did the third memory experiment never reach a verdict?
questions.correct: Four free evaluator models in turn failed to return usable scores

questions.question: How was handoff fidelity measured in the fourth memory experiment?
questions.correct: With a 42-question quiz graded by a script over thirty paired trials
distractors: By two judge models scoring out of 100
By counting words in each handoff

questions.question: What was the verdict of the fourth memory experiment?
questions.correct: REJECT

questions.question: What kind of error did the fourth experiment find?
questions.correct: Only omissions: no wrong fact and nothing invented

questions.question: How many graded answers were involved in that finding?
What can a GitHub Actions workflow now do?
questions.correct: Run an experiment from generation to verdict with repository secrets, without the owner's computer
distractors: Nothing yet: it is still being written

questions.question: What did evaluator calibration show on the two models tested?
questions.correct: Both detected an invented result and kept the required order, and both failed one expected score band
distractors: Both failed to detect the invented result

questions.question: Why were language-model judges replaced by quizzes with known answers?
questions.correct: The judges were the main source of failure and noise

questions.question: What is the purpose of pre-registering an ordered ladder of evaluators?
questions.correct: Replacing a failing model follows the protocol instead of becoming a deviation
distractors: It lets the best-scoring model be chosen
It satisfies a provider's terms of use

questions.question: Who computes score totals?
questions.correct: The code, not the evaluator
distractors: Each evaluator, which is then trusted

questions.question: When must a protocol deviation be recorded?
questions.correct: Before any score it could influence is seen
distractors: Within a week of the experiment
Only if it changes the verdict

questions.question: What is published so that results can be checked?
questions.correct: Raw outputs, answer keys and decisions, so anyone can regrade

questions.question: How did the four-rung evaluator ladder fail?
questions.correct: One returned only reasoning, one was truncated, one stayed rate-limited
distractors: All four disagreed with each other
All four refused on safety grounds

questions.question: Why did published state files disagree with their recorded hashes?
questions.correct: Line endings had been converted on publication
distractors: The files were edited after hashing

questions.question: How was the line-ending problem handled?
questions.correct: The exact bytes were restored and a test now fails on any mismatch
distractors: The hashes were recomputed to match

questions.question: What happened when two evaluator models wrote totals that disagreed with their own components?
questions.correct: The ingestion refused those scorecards
distractors: The totals were corrected by hand
The scorecards were accepted with a warning
The components were recomputed from the totals

questions.question: What does the fifth memory experiment test?
questions.correct: Whether a short generic checklist added after the state increases the facts a handoff transfers
distractors: Whether a larger generator writes better handoffs
Whether JSON beats prose as a state format
Whether two judges agree more than one

questions.question: What is the status of the fifth memory experiment?
questions.correct: Proposed, not yet run

questions.question: Has any experiment of this project reached a provisional keep?
questions.correct: No

questions.question: Which replication step is planned but not started?
questions.correct: Replicating the quiz design with a second generator model from another family
distractors: Training a model on the project data

questions.question: Why should a third evaluation provider be added?
questions.correct: To lift the daily free-quota ceiling
distractors: To reduce the price per request

questions.question: How should the calibration score bands be revised?
questions.correct: As a new anchor-set version, not by editing the version that failed

questions.question: What reproducibility check is planned?
questions.correct: Regrading the published results from the stored reader answers
distractors: Asking another laboratory to repeat the work

questions.question: Which of these is an open question?
questions.correct: Which kinds of fact are dropped most often when a handoff is written
distractors: Which provider is cheapest per token

questions.question: What is the rule about verdicts?
questions.correct: No verdict without at least two independent measurements or a deterministic grader
distractors: A single evaluator is enough if it is strong
Any model may declare a verdict

questions.question: What is the rule about API keys?
questions.correct: They never enter the repository
distractors: They are stored encrypted in the repository
They are printed in the run logs

questions.question: Until when does the map linking a blinded answer to its condition stay private?
questions.correct: Until the scores are frozen

questions.question: What does a final keep require?
questions.correct: Two generator models, a holdout state, evaluator calibration and a regression suite

questions.question: When does a capability claim count?
questions.correct: Only when the evidence is reproducible
distractors: When two models agree on it

questions.question: How much does one experiment cost to run?
Which model generated the handoffs in the fourth memory experiment?
How many people work on the project?
What licence does the repository use?
By how many points did the fourth experiment's two conditions differ?
On what date will the fifth memory experiment finish?
Which country is the project run from?
How many visitors have left a note on the project?
Which operating system does the project run on?
distractors: It runs only in the cloud

questions.question: How long does one handoff take to generate?
